about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Technical excellence across the entire lifecycle of power transmission infrastructure
about.description: JEON is a senior, independent consultancy dedicated to reliability engineering, advanced diagnostics, and technical advisory for high and extra-high voltage transmission assets. We partner with utilities, private investors, and investment funds to foster maximum system reliability, regulatory compliance, and asset profitability across transmission lines and substations.
about.secondaryText: We combine international normative rigor (IEC, IEEE, CIGRÉ, ISO 55001) with extensive hands-on experience throughout the infrastructure lifecycle. For us, precision engineering is the cornerstone of asset preservation, operational risk mitigation, and investment return protection.
about.thirdText: Our advisory intelligence enhances grid reliability and optimizes asset management drastically reducing the impact of regulatory fines and operational outages.

about.photo2Alt: Executive engineering director leading power transmission project

services.title: What We Offer
services.subtitle: High-precision engineering consulting for electric utilities, infrastructure funds, and transmission operators

asset_management.title: Reliability Engineering & Asset Health
asset_management.shortDesc: Advanced diagnostics, failure analysis, and asset preservation guidelines for Transmission Lines and Substations under ISO 55001 standards.
asset_management.fullDesc: In-depth assessment of physical and operational asset integrity. We apply Root Cause Analysis (RCA) methodologies and O&M governance to extend asset lifecycle, optimize performance, and prevent regulatory outages.
deliverables: Development of Strategic Asset Management Plans (SAMP)
Asset health index (AHI) calculation and degradation curve modeling
Root Cause Analysis (RCA) backed by independent expert witness reports
In-company training and specialized continuous education for O&M teams

owners_engineering.title: Technical Auditing & Owner’s Engineering
owners_engineering.shortDesc: Independent analysis and review of basic and detailed engineering designs.
owners_engineering.fullDesc: Technical protection for investors and utilities. We audit transmission line and substation designs prior to and during implementation, promoting strict regulatory compliance, CAPEX optimization, and engineering risk mitigation.
deliverables: Independent review of electromechanical and civil tower foundation designs
Audit of topographic survey coordinates and power line clearances in PLS-CADD
Validation of grounding grid design and insulation coordination margins
Field technical supervision to guarantee compliance with regulatory milestones

fat_inspection.title: FAT Inspection & Technical Witnessing
fat_inspection.shortDesc: Specialized and independent witnessing of type, routine, and acceptance tests for transmission components in domestic and international laboratories.
fat_inspection.fullDesc: On-site and remote presence in global laboratories and manufacturing facilities. We audit test procedures and assess the technical compliance of primary equipment and transmission line components prior to delivery, mitigating premature failures and commissioning delays.
deliverables: On-site independent inspections at global and domestic equipment manufacturers
Witnessing routine and type tests on high-voltage circuit breakers, CT/VTs, and disconnectors
Mechanical and electrical dielectric testing on insulator strings and conductors
Formal non-conformance reporting and secure green-light release certificates

due_diligence.title: Technical Due Diligence & M&A
due_diligence.shortDesc: Comprehensive technical assessment, hidden liability identification, and strategic improvement proposals.
due_diligence.fullDesc: Strategic intelligence for investment funds and asset buyers. We conduct physical and documentary audits across transmission portfolios to quantify operational risks, uncover hidden liabilities, and forecast realistic future investment requirements (CAPEX/OPEX).
deliverables: Sample physical inspections of substations and transmission line corridors
Historical failure audit and regulatory availability factor verification
Identification of hidden technical, environmental, and right-of-way liabilities
Financial modeling of future reinvestment curves (CAPEX) and maintenance budgets (OPEX)
